pictures.name: AS1-Empty-Village
pictures.prompt: An ancient Indian village of thatched mud houses at grey dawn, its lanes empty, doors shut, a cart left behind; far off at the dark edge of a forest stands the shadowy silhouette of Angulimala (a tall, powerfully built young ancient Indian man with wild long black hair, a rough dark wrap, a fierce face; no blood, no injuries, nothing gruesome), too distant to see clearly. Eerie, hushed, not violent. Deep blue shadows, pale gold light.
